text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. Developers often refactor to make their code easier to read and understand. When code is clean and well organized, it is simpler for other programmers to work with and maintain. Refactoring also helps reduce technical debt, which builds up when quick fixes and poor design choices are made. By taking time to refactor regularly, teams can prevent small problems from becoming big ones. In short, refactoring keeps software healthy and makes future changes safer and faster.
